neighbours.label: the word pieces of the nucleotide / nucleoside / nuclide family (nucle|ot, nucle|otide, |ides, |cl|ides), not nucleus or nuclear
fire: The enzyme adds one nucleotide at a time to the growing strand.
Sequencing costs fell once oligonucleotide synthesis became routine.
Each dinucleotide repeat in the region was counted separately.
The assay measures how quickly deoxynucleotide pools are depleted.
Short oligonucleotides were used as primers in the reaction.
Long-lived radionuclides remain a problem for waste storage.
The polynucleotide chain folds back on itself near the loop.
Modified nucleotides are incorporated to label the product.
quiet: The enzyme adds one amino acid at a time to the growing chain.
Sequencing costs fell once primer synthesis became routine.
Each short repeat in the region was counted separately.
The assay measures how quickly ATP pools are depleted.
Short peptides were used as substrates in the reaction.
Long-lived isotopes remain a problem for waste storage.
The protein chain folds back on itself near the loop.
Modified bases are incorporated to label the product.

predictions: Fires on the ot/otide/ides pieces wherever the nucleotide family appears, including oligo- and radio- compounds; nucleus, nuclear and same-domain synonyms stay low.
notes: Card: 'ot' x10, 'otide' x6, ' nucle' x6. Probe: nucleosides 0.971, nucleotides 0.904, nucleotide 0.692, radionuclides 0.663; nucleus 0.087 and nuclear 0.035 are the discriminating misses, so the label excludes them. tok.py: oligonucleotide -> olig|on|ucle|otide, dinucleotide -> din|ucle|otide; 'nucleic' shares ' nucle' and is deliberately kept out of the near misses.
